source_title: 2023 US Census Nonemployer Statistics: Residential building construction proxy
observation: The broad NAICS 2361 proxy contains 839,793 nonemployer businesses and $86.6B receipts.
limitations: Includes new housing construction and remodelers, not only handyman businesses.
Does not identify iPhone or paid-invoicing-app users.

observation: Among 1,050 US home-service owners, jobsite management 48%, customer communication 40%, quoting 37%, paperwork 31% and invoicing 28% are reported time drains; 55% say customers expect a response within an hour.
denominator: US home-service business owners in the vendor survey
limitations: Customer response expectation is owner perception, not a consumer survey.

observation: Jobkore publicly offers photo, voice and PDF to estimate drafting for $29 per month or $290 per year.
limitations: List price is not verified transaction or retention evidence.
The near-identical offer is also a competitive constraint.
Billing channel is not necessarily Apple IAP.

observation: RevenueCat reports Business category median D60 RPI of $0.50 and strong App Store revenue concentration in North America.
unit: USD median D60 RPI, Business category
denominator: RevenueCat-integrated subscription apps included in the 2026 report

source_title: Joist Estimate Invoice Maker US App Store review feed
observation: Reviewed comments report estimate-save work loss, clunky change orders, plan/price pressure and failed estimate or invoice delivery, supporting a source-preserving export reliability problem.
denominator: three inspected recent reviews from a listing with about 13,000 ratings
limitations: The proposed capture companion was not tested.
Review statements were not independently verified.

source_title: Handoff official pricing and feature page
observation: Handoff already markets photo or voice walkthrough to estimate at $119 per month annual-billed or $149 monthly, directly crowding the generic proposed wedge.
unit: USD per month annual-billed list price
limitations: Feature availability does not prove the competitor solves every capture/export problem.

observation: Apple provides a subscription distribution path and requires privacy, consent, minimization, disclosure and security for home photos and third-party AI sharing.
limitations: Compliance path is not approval assurance.
Construction licensing and contract rules vary by jurisdiction.

observation: Public business codes do not isolate solo handyman operators using paid iOS invoicing apps and producing repeated photo or voice estimates.
limitations: Only broader construction and remodeler proxies are available.
